description: Wait for a chat answer; if still running, return the same durable job without cancelling it. For study findings, feedback, comparisons and quotations, use this tool with primary File Search and verified quotations. Resolve ambiguous study names first. Reuse the selected Hub session; if absent create one with create_research_session and a stable retry key, inspect sources and add only missing requested studies. Do not resync unchanged sources or broaden the session silently. After completion always call view_research_answer to display the answer and clickable quote/recording cards inside this conversation, without redirecting to a dashboard; preserve the answer and citation labels. Poll inspect_research_session view=job. Set parent_job_id for a follow-up in the same session. Reuse the same idempotency_key and prompt after a timeout; sync and async share the job.
